origin.description: A condition with classes warning and condition, plus any extra class.

arguments.name: class_
arguments.text: Extra class names, placed in front.

arguments.name: call
arguments.text: The call to store. Default none.

origin.details: The object is returned. It is not signaled. Printing uses R's condition format.
origin.example:
bp_warningCondition <- getFromNamespace("warningCondition", "backports")
print(bp_warningCondition("package backports not found"))
